correctness.rationale: The characteristic subgroups \(O_2(G)=V\) and \(G'=V\rtimes C_5\) separate the five proposed strata together with element order. Their sizes follow from the irreducible \(C_5\)-action and the \(4\)-element fixed spaces of reflections. Exact enumeration of all \(20160\) matrices of \(\operatorname{GL}_4(2)\) finds a \(60\)-element linear normalizer; its \(960\)-element affine extension has conjugation orbit sizes \(1,15,20,60,64\) on all \(160\) group elements, proving transitivity inside every invariant stratum.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The nearest broader orbit-classification literature either stops below five orbits or restricts to simple groups. Neither dominates the claim.
